lines: Parts two and three read a hidden phase. Two states with the same five populations and the same real part differ only in a phase part with two weights, a and b. One call of the installed phase reads a; two calls read a plus b.
第二部和第三部读出的是一处隐藏的相位。两个人口相同、实部也相同的态，只在一个相位部分上不同，这个部分有两个权重 a 和 b。调用一次已安装的相位读出 a；调用两次读出 a + b。
Part six asks which pairs a, b can occur for given populations, and answers without any search.
第六部追问：给定人口，哪些 (a, b) 能真正出现？并且不经过任何搜索就给出答案。
Auric Omega, part six: full population elimination and the finite-root frontier.
AURIC Ω 第六部：全人口消去与有限根前沿。
One candidate, two tests, finitely many roots.
一个候选，两个检验，有限个根。

The original volume reduced the question to the spectrum of the shared real part: four numbers x, y, xi and w. Three population bounds and four product inequalities must all hold for one and the same spectrum.
原卷把问题化归到共同实部的谱：四个数 x、y、ξ、w。三个人口约束和四个乘积不等式，必须由同一个谱同时满足。
Finding such a spectrum is a search in three dimensions. This volume replaces the search by a single candidate, computed directly from the populations and the two weights.
找到这样一个谱，是一次三维搜索。本卷用一个直接由人口和两个权重算出的候选，代替这次搜索。

The candidate's first coordinate X is the largest of three lower bounds: the top population P, a geometric bound h of a, and B over d, where d merges the two population caps. The other three coordinates follow by explicit maxima and minima.
候选的第一个坐标 X 取三个下界中最大的一个：最大人口 P、关于 a 的几何下界 h(a)，以及 B/d，其中 d 合并了两个人口上限。其余三个坐标由显式的最大与最小运算得到。

Membership then needs two inequalities only: X times one minus X at least A plus two B, and the product X Y Z W at least A B. The reason is monotone: along the first coordinate the best product never increases, so the smallest admissible first coordinate is always the best choice.
于是判定只需要两个不等式：X(1 − X) ≥ A + 2B，以及 XYZW ≥ AB。理由是单调性：沿着第一个坐标，可达到的最大乘积从不增加，所以最小的可行第一坐标总是最好的选择。

Every admissible pair comes with explicit states. A real two by two matrix with singular values a over two and b over two is chosen in one of three branches: anti-diagonal, diagonal, or a scaled rotation.
每个可行的 (a, b) 都附带显式的态。一个奇异值为 a/2 和 b/2 的实 2×2 矩阵，从三个分支中选出：反对角、对角，或一个缩放的旋转。
Placed between the square roots of the spectrum, it gives two positive density matrices with the same real part, and one real orthogonal rotation sets the five populations exactly.
把它夹在谱的平方根之间，就得到两个实部相同的半正密度矩阵；再用一个实正交旋转，把五个人口精确地调好。
Now fix the total distance s and ask for the largest second weight. Nineteen polynomials in x and t record every switch of the maxima and minima and both tests.
现在固定总距离 s，追问最大的第二权重。十九个关于 x 和 t 的多项式，记录了最大最小运算的每一次换支，以及两个检验的边界。

Four ways of eliminating x turn them into seventy-six polynomials in t of degree at most eight, so there are at most six hundred and ten candidates. Filter them with the two tests, and the frontier is the largest survivor.
用四种方式消去 x，得到七十六个关于 t 的多项式，次数都不超过八，所以候选至多六百一十个。用两个检验过滤，前沿就是留下来的最大候选。

Take a heavy population: three fifths, one fifth, one tenth, three fiftieths and one twenty-fifth, at distance nine tenths. The root table has twenty-nine distinct candidates and only five pass. The frontier is a root of twenty t squared plus twelve t minus three: two root six minus three, over ten, about zero point one nine. An independent search over spectra gives the same value.
取一组偏重的人口：3/5、1/5、1/10、3/50、1/25，总距离 9/10。根表有二十九个不同的候选，只有五个通过。前沿是 20t² + 12t − 3 的根：(2√6 − 3)/10，约为 0.19。对谱的独立搜索给出同一个值。

Sweeping the distance traces the whole domain. For the lighter populations three tenths, a quarter, a fifth, three twentieths and a tenth, the frontier at distance one is the smallest of one half, one minus two P, and twice V: zero point four. The heavy population never reaches distance one; its largest distance is about zero point nine eight.
让距离扫过整个范围，就描出完整的域。对较轻的人口 3/10、1/4、1/5、3/20、1/10，距离为 1 时的前沿是 1/2、1 − 2P 和 2V 中最小的一个：0.4。偏重的那组人口到不了距离 1，它的最大距离约为 0.98。

With the original fixed menu, the two-call readouts are exactly the pairs s minus b and s, for every b up to the frontier. For rational populations every step is exact real algebra; for arbitrary real inputs, certified roots need exact real arithmetic as an extra resource.
在原来的固定菜单下，两次调用的读数恰好是 (s − b, s)，b 取到前沿为止。对有理人口，每一步都是精确的实代数运算；对任意实数输入，要得到有认证的根，还需要精确实数运算作为额外资源。
These are existence statements. They supply matrices, not preparation procedures, pulse counts or costs, and they add nothing to the original menu.
这些都是存在性结论。它们给出矩阵，不给出制备程序、脉冲数或代价，也不给原菜单增加任何东西。
One candidate instead of a search, two inequalities, an explicit three-branch construction, and a frontier read from finitely many roots.
用一个候选代替搜索，两个不等式，一个显式的三分支构造，以及从有限个根中读出的前沿。

These results are derived in the theory volume from the original common-spectrum interface, with the real Schur–Horn theorem as a classical tool, and every number here was recomputed. Next: the Auric–Langlands volumes, beginning with structure acquisition and spectral extension.
这些结果在理论卷中由原卷的共同谱接口推导出来，所用的经典工具是实 Schur–Horn 定理；这里的每个数字都重新计算过。下一部：AURIC–Langlands 系列，从结构取得与谱延拓开始。
